item.title: Studies in Denmark
item.description: Discover everything you need to know about studying in Denmark - from university applications to student life and cultural adaptation. Get insider tips on Danish universities, student housing, cultural differences, and making the most of your educational journey in one of Europe’s most progressive countries.
How I am trying to navigate life and get the most out of the opportunity, even after the hardest turbulences that happened straight at the start of my studies.

item.title: Music
item.description: Dive into my musical world where passion meets creativity. Here you’ll find my personal remakes of favorite tracks, exclusive recordings from the festivals that moved me most, and deep dives into the sounds that shape our experiences. From underground gems to festival anthems, join me on a sonic journey through the beats that define our generation.

item.title: Photography
item.description: This is the place where you’ll find a collection of my photos — from aviation shots to nature scenes and moments captured on the road. Just like with music, there’s always more to come.
